# ADR-3118: A10: Prefer metadata hop enforcement for cloud workload 10

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

IMDSv1 is trivial via SSRF.

## Decision

Cloud platforms SHOULD prefer metadata hop enforcement for cloud workload 10 (A10-10) when mitigating SSRF credential theft.

## Consequences

IMDSv2 hop limits are mandatory.
